raw_text:
Build a clean, authentic React + Vite + Tailwind CSS ML portfolio for a BCA student learning ML. Showcase ML projects; avoid exaggerated claims or fake expertise. Do NOT claim professional experience not actually achieved or research credentials not earned.

Design: modern developer portfolio/AI dashboard, not flashy marketing or exaggerated personal branding. Primary `#38BDF8`; secondary `#22D3EE`; headings Space Grotesk; H1 for main page headlines. Use reusable, modular, readable React components and clean folder structure; avoid complex code and unnecessary dependencies.

Homepage sections: preserve their specified order. Each section: grid layout content. Project cards include Titanic Survival Prediction; Dataset: Kaggle Titanic Dataset; Model: Logistic Regression; Tools: Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn. Project pages: fade-in section reveal; avoid heavy animations or distracting motion.

Use icons for navigation, skills, and project cards. Mobile-first: responsive grid layouts, readable text on mobile, large touch buttons, lazy loading images.

If technically feasible, implement "Try the Model" interactive section (Titanic survival prediction input form); if complex, skip.

Complete when UI is clean and modern, ML projects clearly presented, portfolio authentic, mobile layout works well, and performance remains fast.
